data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: Phase 1 Gate Step 2 (Intent Gap Analysis) loops back to Tell Me More whenever an intent gap surfaces that genuinely increases epic understanding.
- DD2: The UX probe checkpoint loops back to Tell Me More whenever an intent gap surfaces that genuinely increases epic understanding.
- DD3: Phase 1 termination requires both (a) an empty gap list and (b) user confirmation of the Understanding Summary in the same turn, with no numeric cap.
- DD4: The loop-back state machine consumes the UX probe checkpoint by a named symbol defined in S2's structured probe set (not by hardcoded reference to specific probe content).
- DD5: When the anti-redundancy directive suppresses every candidate question during loop-back, the state machine records UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP on the epic and terminates; a regression test covers this case.
- DD6: Unit tests passing (GREEN — makes RED tests from Task 1 pass).

## Implementation Steps

1. Edit `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md`. In Phase 1 Gate Step 2 ("**Step 2 — Intent Gap Analysis**"), locate the existing "**Bounded gap loop**" paragraph (currently starting with: "**Bounded gap loop**: Ask one question at a time..."). Replace it with the following three paragraphs:

```markdown
**Loop-back directive**: When a gap answer reveals a new understanding gap — one that genuinely increases epic understanding — return to the Tell Me More loop (Step 2) before resuming gap analysis. This applies equally to gaps surfaced by the UX probe checkpoint (any probe from the structured probe set by dimension ID: criticality, non_happy_path, flow_entry_exit) and to gaps surfaced by the intent gap analysis itself.

**Termination condition**: Proceed to Phase 2 only when BOTH: (a) the gap list is empty (no remaining inferred/assumed items) AND (b) the user confirms the Understanding Summary in the same turn. No numeric cap is applied — the anti-redundancy directive bounds the loop in practice.

**UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP escape**: When the anti-redundancy directive suppresses every candidate question during loop-back (all remaining gaps would duplicate questions already asked), record `UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP` as a comment on the epic ticket (`.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <epic-id> "UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP: <reason>"`) and terminate Phase 1 instead of looping indefinitely.
```

2. If `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh` contains assertions for the old termination language ("Terminate when either (a) you have enough to propose approaches or (b) the user says 'proceed'"), update those assertions to match the new termination condition before marking this task complete.

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` — Phase 1 Gate Step 2 amendment
- `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh` — only if it asserts the old termination language

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] SKILL.md contains loop-back directive referencing Tell Me More
  Verify: grep -qiE 'loop.?back.*[Tt]ell [Mm]e [Mm]ore|[Tt]ell [Mm]e [Mm]ore.*loop.?back|return.*[Tt]ell [Mm]e [Mm]ore' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md contains empty-gap-list termination condition
  Verify: grep -qiE 'empty.*gap.*list|gap.*list.*empty|gap list is empty|no.*remaining.*gap' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md contains no-numeric-cap statement
  Verify: grep -qiE 'no numeric cap|no.*cap.*applied|no cap' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md contains UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP escape
  Verify: grep -q 'UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md references UX probe checkpoint by named dimension IDs (not hardcoded probe text)
  Verify: grep -qE 'criticality|non_happy_path|flow_entry_exit' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh exits 0 (GREEN — all assertions pass)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh
- [ ] test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh exits 0 (no regressions)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
